> I read this as implementation - adding a failing-first runtime test for dragging an active terminal tab onto an edge of its own pane.

Added the runtime test to `ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx` using the existing `DndContext` harness and registered pane-edge droppable data. The test asserts that dropping an active terminal tab onto its own rendered pane edge calls `onSplitPane` with the exact target leaf and split options (`"tab-target"`, `"leaf-left"`, `"horizontal"`, `{ position: "second" }`) and does not invoke `onMoveTabToSplit`.

### Verification

Ran only this test via Vitest:

```bash
cd ui && bun run test src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx -t "calls onSplitPane and avoids onMoveTabToSplit"
```

Output confirmed **RED** against current production for the intended reason (`onSplitPane` was not invoked because current production routes same-tab pane-edge drops through `onMoveTabToSplit`, resulting in a reducer no-op):

```
FAIL src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx > TerminalSplitView pane-targeted tab drop > calls onSplitPane and avoids onMoveTabToSplit when dragging an active terminal tab onto an edge of its own pane
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times
  expect(onSplitPane).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
```
